user.title: Idaho Falls Garbage Pickup
user.description: Uses your Home Assistant home location to find your garbage collection day from the City of Idaho Falls. Change the coordinates if needed.

manual.title: Choose your collection day
manual.description: Your collection day couldn't be looked up automatically. Pick it from the city's Sanitation map.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the City of Idaho Falls GIS service.
error.outside_service_area: That location isn't in the city's garbage collection area.

data.collection_day: Collection day (used when auto-detect is off)
data.no_delay_holidays: Holidays that should NOT delay pickup

data_description.auto_detect: Re-checks the city's map daily and updates the day if the city changes it.
data_description.cutoff_hour: After this local hour on pickup day, the Next pickup sensor moves to the following pickup. 24 = end of day.
data_description.extra_delay_dates: Use for city-announced delays (weather, etc.). Pickups on or after that weekday, through Friday, shift one day.

error.invalid_date: Use YYYY-MM-DD dates separated by commas.

holiday_review.title: Check the {year} Idaho Falls holiday pickup schedule
holiday_review.description: The City of Idaho Falls can change which holidays delay garbage pickup from year to year. Compare the {year} holiday schedule at {url} with this integration (Settings > Devices & services > Idaho Falls Garbage > Configure), adjust the options if needed, then dismiss this notice.
